en: Colorized historic postcard view of an ornate Baroque-style garden terrace with stone balustrades, arches, and decorative columns. In the foreground there is a round fountain with a sculptural group on a rock base. In the background, a monumental gate and railings stand above the terrace. On the right, a high pedestal carries a large bird-of-prey statue with spread wings (the Turul). Manicured flowerbeds and paths frame the scene. Printed captions in red at the top identify the place and city.
